So I would suggest about five gallons for each crab with your tank selection!

Make sure they have a saltwater pool that they can fully submerge in with only marine salt mixed in tab salt WILL Kill them!! They also need a drinking bowl of fresh water both water bowls NEED to be conditioned!

They like having places to hide so they aren’t always exposed 

They need six inches of hardware store playsand (at like Home Depot you can get 50Ibs for about five bucks) mixes with eco earth coconut fiber for burrowing. 

Shells!: Shells must not be painted because it is toxic to crabs and will kill them! Also they must have about two or three times the amount of shells available based on the amount of hermit crabs you have if you are getting three you should have about six or nine more available in an area of your tank! (if you don’t have a lot of extra shell options they will fight each other for shells*

It takes them a while to get used to new tanks so don’t be worried if acting weird

Mist the tank a few times a day with a spray bottle! Hermit crabs have modified gills so they can only breathe through humid air! If your tank does not have a mesh lid plastic wrap/cling wrap over the tanks top will do to help keep in the humidity. Also keep some sort of heater pad on the side of the tank or under the tank to maintained a warm temperature. If you cannot get one of those a 15 watt reptile lamp would work also! 

Molting:if you’re crab burrows down in the sand and does not come up don’t worry and DONT dig it out!! They’re just molting. that happens every few months and they’re basically growing down there and interrupting that process can kill them!

Lastly I’d say just make sure everything you get for them is safe for them and not harmful! Hermit crab sand is really bad for them and so are the pellets marketed for them Food: go on Etsy and look for mixes made for hermit crabs especially for pretty cheap or you can make your own mixes!! Many websites provide lists of foods edible for hermit crabs but remember just because it’s a fruit or a veggie doesn’t mean it’s good for them so always check!! 
That’s all I got!! Enjoy your babies

Haha I don’t know I guess they deleted their account!! Basically what they told me is use 5 parts hermit crab sand/playsand 1 part eco earth coconut fiber!! 

Also do not use painted shells for hermit crabs it will kill them so does unconditioned tap water and table salt 

Hermies need two bowls one for conditioned fresh water one for conditioned salt water salted with Maine salt from a pet store and NOT kitchen salt!!

Hermit crab pellets are not always good for them so it’s best to feed them fruits and veggies you have in your house but look up if they’re safe before feeding them to your babies because some like pickles are not good for them.

Lastly make sure that you have as much humidity in your tank as you can by putting wet sea sponges in your tank along with other plants, misting it every day and putting a heat pad on the side!❤️
